## Phase 2 submission eligibility clarification
Submission operations require an explicit selected team and current database membership, including non-captain members. Eligibility is membership in that team associated with its hackathon, subject to the existing deadline and upload constraints. Captain restrictions concern team administration. Membership is rechecked on every operation; organizer status grants no cross-team submission access.

## 2. Personas
Team is derived from membership, not trusted client body.

Submission routes require a team_id UUID query parameter (the smallest compatible addition to existing request bodies and paths); it selects a team but grants no authority. Every operation verifies current database membership and derives hackathon association from that team. All current members may admit and finalize; organizer status alone grants no submission access. Team/hackathon version allocation and principal-scoped admission idempotency use this verified association.
